headline: Pennsylvania would let Attorney General penalize AI requirement violators
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Pennsylvania would give the Attorney General the power to penalize frontier developers that violate requirements for the artificial intelligence they create. Not passed.

171 measures in 40 jurisdictions would require a label, watermark, or disclosure on AI content, or a notice to the people AI is used on.

29 measures in 18 jurisdictions cite the fear that AI is taking people's personal data.

2,248 measures tracked. 756 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
